# Trimble Maps Dwell Time API

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Dwell Time API (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Trimble Maps API key. Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** Trimble Maps API key with Places geofencing.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Maps API key; the API returns live asset positions, which are personal data for drivers.
- **Documented servers:** none in the definition.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/dwell-time](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/dwell-time.json) (Dwell Time API, version 2.0.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/places/dwell-time-api/.

## Asset History

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/geofence/report/account/assets` | `reference` | Get all asset dwell time events associated with an account. | startDateTime (query); endDateTime (query) |
| `GET` | `/geofence/report/account/assets/csv` | `reference` | Get all asset dwell time events in csv form associated with an account. | startDateTime (query); endDateTime (query) |
| `GET` | `/geofence/report/account/places` | `reference` | Get all places dwell time events for all assets associated with an account. | startDateTime (query); endDateTime (query); page (query) |
| `GET` | `/geofence/report/account/places/csv` | `reference` | Get all places dwell time events in csv form for all assets associated with an account. | startDateTime (query); endDateTime (query) |
| `GET` | `/geofence/report/asset/{assetId}/places` | `reference` | Get the history of an asset with places. | assetId* (path); startDateTime (query); endDateTime (query); page (query) |
| `GET` | `/geofence/report/place/{trimblePlaceId}` | `reference` | Get the report of a place. | trimblePlaceId* (path); startDateTime (query); endDateTime (query); assetCategory (query); page (query) |
